name: Olala v1.0 mini 7A1B

Stated context 32K tokens; config allows 100,000. Custom architecture (trust_remote_code): upstream llama.cpp, vLLM and mlx-lm cannot load it, the provider's forks are needed (official GGUF and MLX repos). Generic quantization produces NaN; the provider publishes its recipes. Olala-v1.0-summarise and Olala-v1.0-translate are fine-tunes of this model.

name: Munin 2.0
notes: Hybrid Mamba-2/attention latent MoE (nemotron_h, needs trust_remote_code), 120B total (Hub safetensors count 123.6B), 12B active; 131,072-token context, as in training. Released checkpoint is step 100 of the RL run, chosen partly on the reported agentic benchmarks. The SFT checkpoint (munin-2.0-sft) and an NVFP4 build (munin-2.0-nvfp4, 80 GB) are published. Repo created 2026-11-08, released 2026-11-18.

name: DFM Mimir v1.8
notes: HRM-Text architecture (hrm_text) needs a Transformers/vLLM build with HRM and PrefixLM support; 4,096 context (evaluated at 8,192 with an override). Released weights are the XL EMA export at step 3,800,000. Replaces DFM Mimir v1.5. A smaller model from a separate run, DFM-Mimir-v1.8-Mini (B size, 0.70B, step 1,538,766), is published next to it.

name: Latxa 3 122B-A10B

name: EuroLLM 1.5 9B Base
notes: Base model, not instruction-tuned; weights and card committed 2026-11-15. 9.15B parameters; the config allows 164,000 tokens, the card states no context length. Tier C only because no source yet says how the weights were initialised; re-check when the EuroLLM1.5 technical report appears. The instruction-tuned EuroLLM1.5-9B-SFT (preview release, weights from 2026-08-29) has no licence in its card, metadata or repo and is not listed.

name: Villanova2 15B-A3B
notes: Instruction-tuned sparse MoE (64 routed experts, top-8, plus one shared): 15.5B total, 3.9B active; 21 Gated DeltaNet and 7 full-attention layers (model type qwen3_next). 131,072-token context, usable context measured up to 32k. Thinking mode is on by default in the chat template; the published scores are with thinking off. Gated with automatic approval (contact details; no gate terms in the card metadata); card read from the public model page, repo files not read. Siblings: Villanova2-2B (dense 2.4B), vision-language variants and official GGUF builds.

name: Embla 1
notes: Reasoning model for phones: 10B total (7.0B in the weights file plus a 3B-parameter engram table in a separate file), 1B active per token, 262,144-token context, ChatML with a <think> block. The bf16 repo is the master checkpoint; the model is trained quantization-aware for 4 bit and runs on-device from sevren-ai/Embla1-4bit. Custom architecture (trust_remote_code); mlx-lm does not load it, Sevren's embla-metal runtime does.

name: Lara Mini Base
notes: Non-commercial licence (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); gated with manual review (name, affiliation, non-commercial use). Base model, not instruction-tuned, no safety tuning; requires trust_remote_code. 7.3B parameters on the Hub (card: 7.2B total, 0.6B active); 131,072-token context. Card read from the public model page; LICENSE, NOTICE and the third-party licence files were not read (gate).

name: Tencent Hy4
notes: 770B-A49B MoE backbone plus 1.23B ViT and 3.3B DFly2 drafter for speculative decoding (Hub counts 774.4B); text, image and video input; 1M context. Final release, replaces Hy4 preview; repo created 2026-10-29, files last updated 2026-11-20. FP8 weights in tencent/Hy4-FP8, pre-trained base in tencent/Hy4-base.

name: Tencent Hy4 flash
notes: 220B stored: 155.5B MoE backbone (11.3B active, 16 of 512 latent experts), 63.5B Engram n-gram embedding tables, 0.43B ViT, 0.85B DFly2 drafter; sparse and sliding-window attention interleaved 1:3; 1M context. Repo created 2026-11-17. FP8 weights in tencent/Hy4-flash-FP8, pre-trained base in tencent/Hy4-flash-base.

name: Sarvam-105B-1711
notes: Sarvam-105B base model with further post-training (tool calling, instruction following, agentic tasks, Indian languages); replaces Sarvam-105B. MoE 105B / 10.3B active, MLA attention; trust_remote_code. BF16 original; the NVFP4 build is sarvamai/sarvam-105b-1711. Evaluated by Sarvam at 131,072 tokens.

name: Qwen-SEA-LION v5 397B-A17B Plus
base_model: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B (converted to Qwen4Exp; n-gram tables seeded from Qwen3.8-Flash-Next)
notes: About 398B effective parameters, 569B with the n-gram tables (about 164B), about 19B active. Qwen3.5-397B-A17B converted to Qwen4Exp, the architecture of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (15 full-attention layers to Qwen Sparse Attention, Gated Residual, hashed n-gram embedding), then post-trained; video input, 262K context. The card states MIT, but the n-gram tables are seeded from the trained tables of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, which is under the Qwen Community License 1.0 (separate licence for Model-as-a-Service and AI work-assistant businesses, also for derivative works); the card does not address this and how the two interact was not checked. Training is 'experimental and still in progress'. FP8, NVFP4 and GGUF builds in the aisingapore organisation.

name: Qwen-SEA-LION v5 27B
notes: Post-trained Qwen3.8-27B with the architecture unchanged (dense 27.8B hybrid of Gated DeltaNet and attention, vision encoder); video input, 262K context; the MTP head was trained along with the model.

name: Inkling 2 Small
notes: Not gated. MoE 594B total / 17B active (8 of 384 experts per token), 48 layers, 1M context. Announced 2026-11-05 on Tinker; weights on the Hub since 2026-11-12. The main checkpoint is NVFP4, the precision the model was trained in, and needs about 500 GB of GPU memory; an MXFP8 version is in Inkling-2-Small-MXFP8.

name: Inkling 2 Mini
notes: Not gated. Released 2026-11-20. Looped MoE transformer: 26.4B total / 3.4B active (8 of 128 experts), 24 layers of which the middle 12 run three times; 1M context. One checkpoint of about 20 GB in the precision it was trained in (NVFP4, last four layers MXFP8). Its own training run on the Inkling 2 recipe, not cut out of Inkling 2 Small: two thirds of the experts pruned in midtraining, then 1T tokens distilled from a larger internal Inkling model. No AI Act summary was listed for it on 2026-11-21, one day after release. A variable-loop research sibling is published as TML-d24-varloop-research.

name: Aion 1.0 Instruct 2.3B
notes: On the Hub since 2026-11-18, announced 2026-11-19; not gated. Dense 2.29B, 28 layers (21 sliding-window, 7 full-attention), 32K context; needs trust_remote_code (custom model code). Unquantized weights; Microsoft also publishes an INT4 ONNX WebGPU build (Aion-1.0-Instruct-2.3B-ONNX-WebGPU). Second Microsoft comparison model next to Phi-4-Reasoning-Vision.

name: Kolibri 1.1
notes: German/English MoE, 75B total, 3.4B active; sparse attention in every fifth layer, sliding window in the others. 262,144 tokens native context; the card allows up to 1,048,576 with an override and recommends at most 262,144 for complex tasks. Successor of Kolibri 1, released 2026-11-23: continues a Kolibri 1 mid-training checkpoint, then its own SFT and RL. FP8 release, served with vLLM through the aleph-alpha-inference plugin; official GGUF quantizations in Aleph-Alpha/Kolibri-1.1-GGUF, which llama.cpp cannot load until pull request ggml-org/llama.cpp#32891 is merged (GGUF card, 2026-11-23). Synthetic data: the AI Act summary lists Gemma-4-26B-A4B, Qwen3-32B, Qwen3.8-27B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, GLM-5.2, GLM-5.3, Kimi-K2.6, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and two abliterated community variants. RESPONSIBLE_USE.md is guidance, not a condition of the licence. Definitive merger agreement with Cohere (Canada) signed 2026-09-16, pending approval.
